description: Submit a durable async task to this mesh node. Returns a task_id; poll nexus_task_status or supply callback_url for push delivery. Every finished task issues an Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt.

callback_url.description: public HTTPS URL invoked with the signed result on finish

payload_value.description: declared value of the task, for telemetry and billing

name: nexus_coordinate
title: Submit a durable task for verifiable execution
